description: Use after vendor_risk_assessment when the user needs to act on a vendor's gaps. Returns every gap with an action, the evidence to request from the vendor, ISO 27001 / GDPR / NIS2 / DORA references and a roadmap (before signing first), plus the contract clauses to include (GDPR Art. 28, NIS2 Art. 21, DORA Art. 30 when they apply). Requires ClevSec Pro.

bcp1.description: Does the vendor have a business continuity / disaster recovery plan?

bcp2.description: Does the vendor offer a defined SLA with uptime guarantees?

bcp3.description: Can data be exported/migrated if you terminate the relationship?

bcp4.description: Does the vendor have geographic redundancy for critical services?

bcp5.description: Is the vendor financially stable (no signs of distress)?

com1.description: Is the vendor compliant with GDPR (if processing EU personal data)?

com2.description: Will the vendor sign a Data Processing Agreement?

com3.description: Does the vendor provide right-to-audit or access to audit reports?

com4.description: Does the vendor's contract include security requirements and SLAs?

com5.description: Does the vendor have adequate insurance coverage (cyber liability)?

criticality.description: How critical is this vendor to your operations?
enum: Critical — essential service, no easy replacement

dataAccess.description: What data will this vendor access?

inc1.description: Does the vendor have a documented incident response plan?

inc2.description: Will the vendor notify you of security incidents within 24-48 hours?

inc3.description: Has the vendor experienced any data breaches in the last 3 years?

inc4.description: Does the vendor conduct incident response exercises/tabletop tests?

regimes.description: Which of these apply to your organization? (optional)

sec1.description: Does the vendor hold relevant security certifications (ISO 27001, SOC 2, etc.)?

sec2.description: Does the vendor have a documented information security policy?

sec3.description: Does the vendor encrypt data at rest and in transit?

sec4.description: Does the vendor enforce multi-factor authentication?

sec5.description: Does the vendor conduct regular penetration testing?

sec6.description: Does the vendor have a vulnerability management program?

sec7.description: Does the vendor perform background checks on employees with data access?

sup1.description: Does the vendor disclose its key subprocessors/subcontractors?

sup2.description: Will the vendor notify you before changing subprocessors?

sup3.description: Does the vendor assess the security of its own suppliers?

sup4.description: Are subprocessor contracts held to the same security standards?

title: Vendor due diligence plan and contract clauses (ClevSec Pro)
